notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 Object Class Table cross-field preflight: when a composed object attribute has data type NA, supplied transportation and order values must be non-NA, while supplied update type and update condition values must be NA. The official DIF XSD has no per-attribute available-dimensions field, so that source phrase cannot be mapped without inventing a class-level restriction (RL-051). DIF modules can omit companion fields; Umbra validates the fields actually present after compatible modules merge, and the FDD schema still requires transportation and order before a complete FDD can materialize. Generic transportation reference resolution remains responsible for a non-NA named transportation type. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
